subject: Pilot MAP & Credits — finalizing ramp milestones and conversion pricing
messages:
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@heliovolt.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Jorge Sanchez <jorge.sanchez@heliovolt.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot MAP and credits — ask for extension and clarifications

Alex — thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our team took the evaluation plan (MAP) back to engineering and finance. Two asks to help us hit the executive milestone next week:

1) Can Redwood extend the pilot credit pool by one additional week? Our E2E tests slipped and we need the extra run to validate throughput at 4k tokens/sec.
2) We need a clearer conversion pricing ladder tied to MAP milestones (ramp, commit, 3-month discount for initial commit). 

Attached is our internal timeline and the MAP spreadsheet we received. Can you propose exact dates and a simple conversion say: commit within 30 days = 15% credit; commit within 60 days = 10% credit? Also copying procurement (procurement@heliovolt.com) — they’ll need SOW and formal PO language if we proceed.

Thanks,
Taylor Nguyen
Principal Product Manager
Heliovolt Energy

Attachment: Heliovolt-internal-eval-timeline.xlsx (spreadsheet, 92KB)
From: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@heliovolt.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP and credits — ask for extension and clarifications

Taylor — appreciate the clear asks and the timeline you sent. Proposal below mirrors the MAP milestones and ties the commercial items to delivery so execs can sign off quickly. High level: we can do a 7-day pilot credit extension and lock a conversion ladder conditioned on hitting three MAP milestones.

Proposed MAP + Commercials (concise):
- Milestone 1 (Integration complete, smoke tests): target 2026-02-28 — Redwood extends pilot credits + 1 week (adds 50k tokens of credit).
- Milestone 2 (Performance validation at 4k tokens/sec + KV caching): target 2026-03-06 — if met, Heliovolt qualifies for an early-conversion credit = additional 10% one-time credit toward first invoice.
- Milestone 3 (Production readiness, security signoff, SSO): target 2026-03-20 — if met and customer signs a 6-month committed capacity, Redwood offers an onboarding discount of 15% applied over the first 3 invoices.

Conversion pricing ladder (example):
- Convert (sign contract) within 30 days of pilot end: 15% onboarding discount and 20k bonus credit.
- Convert within 60 days: 10% onboarding discount and 10k bonus credit.
- No convert after 60 days: standard list pricing.

We’ll document these in the MAP spreadsheet (I updated Heliovolt-MAP-v3.xlsx) and can include the commitments in the SOW draft for procurement. Marissa — can you confirm CS acceptance criteria (test suite thresholds) and whether the 50k extension is sufficient for their remaining tests? Karthik — any infra or perf caveats?

I’ll follow up with a short canary clause for capacity fallback and a DocuSign-ready SOW if procurement is ready.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Heliovolt-MAP-v3.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@heliovolt.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T13:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP and credits — ask for extension and clarifications

Thanks Alex/Taylor — quick note from CS on acceptance criteria. Keeping it minimal so Heliovolt can close quickly: 

Must-pass items for Milestone 2 (performance validation):
- 95th percentile < 200ms for generation at sample load (2k steady, 4k burst)
- KV cache hit-rate >= 60% for canonical prompt set (I added a sample prompt file in the spreadsheet)
- No P0 errors across 48-hour soak test

If these are met, CS will sign the Milestone 2 acceptance email and Alex — that triggers the 10% credit you listed. The 50k token extension is OK to run the soak and re-run the long prompt cases, but if Heliovolt needs a second extension we should evaluate after the soak window.

Also, small ask on the SOW: include a 30-day rollback clause and data retention SLA note (we keep inference logs for 90 days by default). Attached is a redline-friendly SOW draft I’ll share with procurement.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW_Draft.pdf (PDF, 160KB)
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@heliovolt.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP and credits — ask for extension and clarifications

Couple of technical clarifications from infra/SE side:
- For the 4k tokens/sec validation we recommend a short warm-up (15 minutes) to prime KV caches. Please run the soak with the same input distribution you used in the demo.
- If Heliovolt plans to test long-context (16k+) sessions, we should explicitly note that the performance profile shifts; we can provide an alternate quantized model variant that reduces token cost by ~20% but adds a 10–15ms median latency.

If you want, I can join the final performance validation call next Friday (2026-03-06) to help triage. Also, we should make sure the MAP spreadsheet lists the exact datasets for the KV hit-rate check. I added a 'DataSets' tab in the spreadsheet.

Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Jorge Sanchez <jorge.sanchez@heliovolt.com>
To: alex_martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor.nguyen@heliovolt.com>
Cc: procurement@heliovolt.com
Date: 2026-02-27T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP and credits — ask for extension and clarifications

Alex — this looks good. Procurement is comfortable with the proposed 7-day extension and the milestone-tied credits as long as the SOW includes:
- Clear deliverables for each milestone (we should reference the MAP spreadsheet by name/version).
- Billing triggers and invoice timing tied to sign-off emails from Redwood CS.
- Standard IP and confidentiality language.

We plan to issue a PO by 2026-03-08 pending the SOW. Two asks before PO: can you send the DocuSign-ready SOW and a redline-friendly Word version? Also confirm the final list price for the committed capacity (we need the dollar figures to push this through finance).

If you can provide the two SOW formats and the final price list by EOD Friday (2026-02-27 PST), we’ll circulate internally and aim to sign next week.

Regards,
Jorge Sanchez
Procurement Manager
Heliovolt Energy
